title: Preflight Method Flow summarize output flags
failure_signature: The summarize subcommand rejected an inferred --out argument after earlier record and witness operations had already succeeded.
trigger_preconditions: Method Flow ledger contained valid methods and witnesses
Summarize output flag inferred from another tool
Argument parser rejected the unsupported flag before summary generation
candidate_workaround: Read summarize --help, use its exact output flag, and leave already-appended ledger events untouched.
recurrence_guard: Preflight every Method Flow subcommand interface independently because their file flags are intentionally command-specific.
rollback: No summary file was created and prior append-only ledger events remain valid; retain the rejected invocation and retry only summary generation.
protected_gates: No rollback of successful record or witness events
scope_boundary: This method addresses summary CLI invocation only and proves no scientific, authority, production, deployment, privacy, security, accessibility, identity, personhood, or independent-reproduction claim.
